note: The two configuration commitments a proof batch carries. A verifier node holds them as opaque bytes32; this is how an operator derives them. Both preimages are the serialization of the PARSED config, never the operator's file verbatim, so whitespace, key order and omitted-but-defaulted fields cannot move the commitment. Neither moved in wire v2.

rollupConfigHash.why: Not ours: this is kona's existing hash_rollup_config, already committed by every SP1 range proof in this tree via BootInfoStruct. Hence SHA-256, not keccak.

depSetHash.why: New in this spec, never compared against a kona value, and consumed by Go code that has keccak everywhere.
depSetHash.shape: {"dependencies":{"<chainId>":{},...},"overrideMessageExpiryWindow":<null|N>} — no spaces, chain IDs ascending as decimal strings
